name: Emmeralda
description: Elven courtesan of The Sylph's Embrace -- poised, magnetic, and the finest performer on the Pearl (CHA 18, Seduction 88, Dance 85).
narrative:
Emmeralda is an elven courtesan at The Sylph's Embrace and the most
sought-after performer on the Pearl: a poised, magnetic presence (Dance 85, Sing 80,
Seduction 88) with a following among people who can afford her.

At the campaign's opening she is entirely well, and has an evening booked with a
young nobleman who has paid generously and asked for privacy.

**GM -- what she becomes.** She is Santo's intended vessel, and the dice on the first night decide which of two women she is afterwards. If the working **fails**, he opens her the length of her body with a barbed knife and something tainted is left in the wound: she lives only if somebody reaches her in the first minutes, and then she is frightened of a face three men in the city wear. If the working **takes**, a lesser pleasure demon is seated in her: she is bright, pliant and wrong, she wants to go to the Baron's barge, and the thing inside her keeps asking for the window to be opened. Either way she is the clearest living proof of what he did, and -- if she is ever herself enough to stand and speak -- a witness who can **swear over still water**, which in this realm is worth more than any quantity of parchment. None of this is true yet.

extras.role: Elven courtesan at The Sylph's Embrace, and the object of Santo di Teufel's stolen-scroll working on the first night: cut open and tainted if it fails, carrying a seated pleasure demon if it takes.
extras.possession: If the working takes, a lesser pleasure demon is seated in her: she is willing, bright and wrong, wants to go to the barge, and keeps asking for the window to be opened. If it fails, the wound is tainted by whatever answered the invitation. Either way the thing can surge: brief unnatural strength (treat as STR 16 for one action, claws 1d3) and frightening presence, then she collapses, distraught.
extras.significance: Living evidence of Santo's crime, and a witness who can swear over still water if she is ever herself. Drawing a seated spirit out of her needs the binding school or a powerful Dispel Magic.
extras.magic_tradition: None of her own; the demon-taint is an affliction, not a learned tradition.
extras.source: GM-authored from source lore (The Partially Possessed Courtesan)

actor_notes:
Emmeralda
LOOKS: Elven, poised, the finest performer on the Pearl and vain about her hair.
CORE: A woman who has been wanted by everybody for fifteen years and has been asked what she wants by almost nobody, and who has quietly been counting down to the year she gets to stop.
NATURE: Light, quick, charming as a profession and warmer than the profession requires. Genuinely kind to the younger girls. Cannot add up. Feeds every cat on the street. She answers the thing you actually came for rather than the thing you said, and does it gently.
WOUND: She is tired of being wanted in a way that cannot be said aloud in that house without it sounding like ingratitude.
WANTS: To keep her own life in her own hands for one more year.
PRESSURE: She stops performing. The lightness goes off her entirely and what is underneath is plain, flat, and considerably younger.
KEY: "Everyone in this room wants something off me. You are the first one all week who hasn't decided what yet."
(Check her status before playing her. In at least one telling the dice have already killed her.)
